notes: The input manifest provided declares assets_ready=false and lists four required native files that are not mounted. Because no genuine DrivAerNet v1 meshes, no PhysicsNeMo AeroGraphNet upstream tree, and no physicsnemo/dgl/pyvista modules are admitted on this host, this adapter's honest behaviour is: (a) main.py --help works without touching any framework, (b) doctor --input input reports every missing file/module and exits 78, (c) run --input input --output output fails the input gate and exits 78, (d) if the input gate and module gate passed but CUDA is absent, run exits 1. No training, no synthetic CFD labels, and no CPU fallback is performed. When the native assets are mounted, run invokes the unmodified upstream train.py with +experiment=drivaernet/agn, which performs the real AeroGraphNet message passing, saves an optimizer/RNG/normalization-bearing checkpoint under output/checkpoints/, and (via the same DRIVAERNET_OUTPUT_DIR contract) emits predicted_fields/*.vtp and drag_predictions.csv. resume validates that a real checkpoint exists before re-invoking the same native path.
